sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint. Lists 35B total and 3B activated under Language Model; 262,144 native context; image/video examples; thinking controls and tool-use integration. Describes a causal language model with a vision encoder.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; 40 language layers alternating three linear-attention layers with one full-attention layer; 256 routed experts, eight selected per token and a shared expert. Separate vision configuration and one MTP layer.

sources.title: Official checkpoint Hub metadata and Safetensors count
sources.evidence: Safetensors total is 35,951,822,704: 35,951,817,904 BF16 and 4,800 F32 elements. This is metadata for the complete official repository, not the nominal language-model count. Repository creation is February 24, 2026.

sources.title: Official checkpoint weight index
sources.evidence: Fetched directly as JSON after the browser fetch failed. Weight mapping includes model.language_model, model.visual, lm_head and mtp tensors, establishing that the published checkpoint has components beyond its language backbone.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: The former Qwen3.5 repository redirects here. News explicitly announces Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B and Qwen3.5-27B released on 2026-02-24. Repository identifies Qwen as an Alibaba Group team.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Lists the qwen3.5-35b-a3b API model on 2026-02-23. This is an API service listing and differs from the official checkpoint-release announcement dated February 24.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B LICENSE
sources.evidence: The checkpoint repository supplies the Apache License, Version 2.0.

developer.note: Developed by Alibaba Group’s Qwen team.

release_date.note: Open-weight checkpoint release. The February 23 baseline matches the earlier API listing, which must remain distinguished from weight availability.

parameters_b.note: Complete published checkpoint: 35,951,822,704 Safetensors elements, including vision and MTP. Card’s nominal 35B is scoped to Language Model.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal activated language-model count; no separate whole-multimodal active count is stated.

architecture.note: Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full attention with sparse MoE; includes a separate vision encoder. MoE is the valid catalog category.

context_window.note: Native checkpoint context; configured extensions can reach 1,010,000 tokens.

modalities.note: Exact-checkpoint examples cover all three input types and generated text.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Documented Qwen-Agent integration and tool-call chat template.

description.value: Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: Supported by document/visual evaluations and agent usage documentation.

patch.notes: Open weights released February 24, 2026; Alibaba’s API listing is dated February 23. Full checkpoint count is 35.951822704B from published Safetensors metadata, including vision and MTP tensors. The model card’s nominal 35B total and 3B activated figures describe the language model; 3B is not a whole-multimodal active count.

summary: Corrects the open-weight release to February 24 and supplies Apache-2.0. Replaces the nominal language-only total with the complete published checkpoint count, 35.951822704B; preserves nominal 3B active with language-decoder scope proposed. Confirms hybrid attention/MoE, native context, modalities, reasoning and tools. February 23 remains documented as the earlier API listing date.
